messages:
alina: Heads-up — planning a small canary for v2.4.1 tonight 23:00 UTC. Goal: validate latency regression fixes + kv-cache behavior under long-tail seqs.

alina: Proposed ramp: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% over 30m steps (10m gating checks). Regions: eu-west-1 primary, us-east-1 as secondary.

alina: Need: deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback ready + quick checklist (feature flags, model pin). Any objections?

kevin: I can own the deploy. I’ll be on call during the window.

sam: I’ll take smoke tests. Plan to run the usual perf + quality set and validate responses for the regression prompt set.

jen: @kevin please make sure release includes the pinned quantized variant for eu-west-1. Also confirm autoscaler settings — last time we saw a brief spike.

kevin: noted. I’ll pin v2.4.1-q8 and set max burst to 2x for first 15m.

maria: For cohort selection, can we use the existing micro-bucket that targets 0.5% of traffic across authenticated web calls only? avoids mobile apps for now.

alina: yes, use micro-bucket 'canary-web-auth' — excludes mobile and internal traffic. Good call.

ops_lead: Rollback plan: immediate pin back to v2.4.0 if error rate > 1% or p99 latency increases > 200ms sustained for 5m. Who executes rollback?

kevin: I’ll roll back if those gates hit. I’ll notify in #eng-releases and #oncall.

sam: Smoke script I’ll run after each step:
```bash
./scripts/smoke.sh --env canary --checks health,latency,correctness --sample 200
# exit code 0 = pass
```

sam: I’ll post a short summary in-thread after each smoke run + a small artifact link with diffs.

jen: Quick note on metrics: make sure the canary dashboard has the new latency breakdown by sequence length (>1024 tokens). I enabled the panel.

maria: Also watch model-level tokenation errors — we had a handful last release. I’ll tail logs for tokenization exceptions.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by kevin for 2026-04-02 23:00 UTC. Canary cohorts configured: 0.5%, 2%, 10%. Notification channels set: #eng-releases, #oncall.

alina: Perfect. Final checklist for tonight:
- kevin: deploy owner + rollback action (confirmed)
- sam: smoke owner + artifacts (confirmed)
- jen: config pin + autoscaler tweak (confirmed)
- maria: logs/tokenation watch (confirmed)
- ops_lead: gate thresholds and rollback criteria (confirmed)

alina: If no blockers, proceed. Otherwise call it out before 21:30 UTC so we can delay.

kevin: No blockers from infra side. I’ll post live updates during ramp.

sam: I’ll be ready at 22:45 UTC to kick off the first smoke run after the initial 0.5% bump.

maria: I’ll watch logs from 23:00-00:30 UTC.

ops_lead: I’ll be reachable and will coordinate with SRE if we need a cross-region failover.

alina: Thanks team — proceeding as planned. I’ll follow up tomorrow with a short post-deploy note. :thumbsup:
